module: Milestones related to speed traps (gameplay_speedTraps) in career: speed record reached in front of a speed trap (velocitySpeedTrapMilestone, tiers 70, 90, 120, 150, 180 and 220 km/h stored in m/s) and total number of speed trap triggers by the player (speedTrapTriggerCounterMilestone, 10 tiers of 15 triggers). The per-individual-speed-trap and "all speed traps" milestones are disabled (commented-out code).
notes: Bug: `M.onGeneralMilestoneClaimed = registerStastisticCallback` references a variable that does not exist in this file (copy-paste from statistic.lua): it is nil, so the exported field is nil.
The trigger counter does not stop at maxStep (10): getTarget(step) = step*15 is never nil, so triggerCount keeps increasing and so does notificationStep.
onSpeedTrapTriggered ignores speed traps without a speedLimit and those triggered by a vehicle other than player vehicle 0.

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: creates the two active milestones (speed record and counter) with their save data (maxVelocityReachedByPlayer, triggerCount) and adds them to milestonesList.

onSpeedTrapTriggered.desc: Hook called when a speed trap triggers: updates the player's speed record, notifies all speed tiers passed, and increments the trigger counter.
